extra_vocab.en: in a regular way, without stopping or changing suddenly
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，has risen steadily 表示培訓成本「一路穩定上升、沒有停過」。語感是持續、有規律的變化，常用來描述數字或趨勢，比 suddenly（突然地）更強調過程平穩。

example.en: Prices have risen steadily over the past three years.
example.zh: 過去三年來物價持續穩定上漲。

example.en: Our profits grew steadily during the first half of the year.
example.zh: 我們的利潤在上半年穩定成長。

example.en: Customer satisfaction improved steadily after we changed the service process.
example.zh: 調整服務流程後，客戶滿意度穩定提升。

example.en: Office costs declined steadily after we moved to a smaller building.
example.zh: 搬到較小的大樓後，辦公室成本持續下降。

examples.en: Our team worked steadily through the afternoon to meet the deadline.
examples.zh: 我們團隊整個下午持續不間斷地工作，以趕上截止期限。

examples.en: Demand for our service has increased steadily since the launch.
examples.zh: 自推出以來，市場對我們服務的需求持續增加。

examples.en: The rain fell steadily all morning, so the outdoor event was moved indoors.
examples.zh: 雨整個早上下個不停，所以戶外活動改到室內舉行。

confusable.diff: gradually 強調「慢慢地、一點一點地」改變；steadily 強調「持續、穩定、不中斷」。兩者有時可互換，但 steadily 更著重過程平穩。
constantly 是「經常、不斷重複」，多用於一再發生的事（常帶抱怨）；steadily 指穩定地朝同一方向變化。

example.en: We have a steady flow of new customers every month.
example.zh: 我們每個月都有穩定的新客戶。

example.en: The company wants a stable income from its services.
example.zh: 公司希望從服務中獲得穩定的收入。

example.en: Job stability is important to many of our employees.
example.zh: 工作穩定對許多員工來說很重要。
